Human Sensing & Digital Twin

Marketplace Conference | 3-4 November 2026, Berlin

 
 

From Human Data Acquisition to Digital Human Modeling

Join us for the Human Sensing & Digital Twin Conference, a dedicated meeting exploring the technologies connecting human sensing, digital twins, and human modeling. The forum brings together researchers, engineers, technology developers, and industry leaders to showcase advances in sensing technologies, simulation platforms, and data-driven human models, creating new opportunities across wearable technologies, robotics, healthcare, and human performance applications.

Interdisciplinary meetup: who should attend

  • Researchers, engineers, and developers in human sensing and digital human technologies

  • Providers of sensing, wearable, simulation, and digital twin technologies

  • Developers of AI, human modeling, and data-driven analysis solutions

  • Industry stakeholders in wearable robotics, rehabilitation, ergonomics, and human performance
